title: Hierarchical Structures
description: See how multiscale biological architectures like nacre and collagen use interfaces to increase toughness and inspire composite design.

learning_objectives.statement: Understand the concept of multiscale hierarchical organization in biological materials
Examine how nano-to-macro scale design enhances toughness
Translate multiscale material principles to composite engineering

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
